policy: Select from the user's intent and verified project, not a substring classifier. Compose only required phases; profiles are registrations, not proof of callable tools. Skills/CLIs remain usable across all five providers. Never change models, grant trust, handle secrets, publish or control a game merely because a recipe mentions it.

tasks.when: Implement or refactor a substantive source repository
checks: Real project tests and build; graph index limited to source
Reproduce the symptom, add regression coverage, rerun the suite
notes: Compose code only when symbol/graph navigation settles the bug; no browser for a parser failure

tasks.when: Build, polish or test a rendered web interface
checks: Build, browser interaction, console/network, inspect rendered pixels and accessibility
notes: Prefer a sufficient native browser; shadcn only when components.json exists

tasks.when: Create a browser game or interactive image-based scene
checks: Playable vertical slice, inputs/collision/state reset, frame-time and rendered output
notes: Use img2threejs only for an image-to-scene phase; desktop engine bridges are unrelated

tasks.when: Create a game in an owned Unity editor project
checks: Exact Unity/package version, editor connection, compile, Play Mode smoke test, build and rendered capture
notes: Unity editor control is not a Unity game mod loader; compose assets-3d only for actual mesh/animation work

tasks.when: Create a game in an owned Unreal source/editor project
checks: Discover installed Unreal version/build tools, compile/cook/package, runtime inputs and rendered capture
notes: No audited Unreal editor MCP ships in this bundle. Use discovered engine CLI/editor capabilities; do not claim a bridge or enable Unity instead

tasks.when: Create or repair a Godot project
checks: Discover GODOT_PATH, exact version, parse/run project, inspect errors, gameplay and rendered capture

tasks.when: Create or repair a Roblox/Roblox Studio project
checks: Studio bridge, real place test and receipts; filesystem validation alone is not Studio runtime proof

tasks.when: Mod an unfamiliar installed game or choose its real engine/loader route
checks: Read-only recon, exact game/loader API, owned lab and one working slice before bulk work
notes: After recon compose the verified game family; a packaged Unity/Unreal game is not an editable engine project

tasks.when: Mod a packaged Unity game through its verified loader/API
checks: Mono vs IL2CPP, installed loader/Harmony versions, compile and real loader/runtime log
notes: Do not enable engine-unity: a shipped game does not contain the editor project's Library MCP binary

tasks.when: Mod a packaged Unreal game through its verified loader/API
checks: Exact UE/game/loader version and signatures, owned mod output, loader acceptance and gameplay test
notes: UE4SS modding is not Unreal editor control; do not guess offsets or Blueprint APIs

tasks.when: Author or repair a Skyrim mod in its owned source workspace
checks: Exact source/plugin/compiler evidence, optional installer branches, asset provenance and runtime gap
notes: Forge and Spooky CLI work without a named Hermes game profile; compose load-order only when installed-list evidence is required

tasks.when: Need true winners/conflicts from the configured Skyrim manager instance
checks: Real manager instance and read-only winner query; preserve the user's tool filter

tasks.when: Author or repair a supported Saints Row mod
checks: Verified game/version, asset/build/dependency checks and in-game runtime gap
notes: Use the installed Forge CLI on Hermes when no native Saints Row profile exists

tasks.when: Create/import/export meshes, materials, rigs, animations or 3D-to-sprite assets
checks: Blender addon reaches scene, units/origin/materials/rig/export, target-engine import and visual preview
notes: For Skyrim additionally load skyrim-assets-pbr/skyrim-nif. No paid fal calls or ComfyUI downloads by default

tasks.when: Prepare a presentable repository, game/app release or mod publication
checks: Credits/permissions, truthful screenshots/previews, real CI/security gates, exact-SHA package and downloaded-byte checks
notes: For Skyrim load skyrim-nexus-publishing. Preparation does not authorize public publishing

tasks.when: Verify current technical facts, APIs or upstream compatibility
checks: Current primary sources or installed runtime evidence; no inferred signatures
notes: Use core Context7/native web first; compose web-ui only for real browser interaction

tasks.when: Operate or diagnose a local model/server or its hardware budget
checks: Actual route/context/VRAM fit, tool-template behavior, auxiliary/fallback privacy and startup logs
notes: Preserve model choices; do not enable unrelated engine/browser servers

tasks.when: The task genuinely requires Windows app UI control unavailable natively
checks: Discover actual window/control, bounded operation and observed UI result
notes: Windows MCP remains off by default. Hermes uses native computer tools or an explicitly configured desktop profile; no silent global opt-in
